rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Sequential read of chunks 0-2: JTBD, branch, obstacle, bottleneck, and the two plans are named before later pronouns or shorthand reuse them.
Line 63 names the next document, "Test the sharing plan", and no positional callback such as an opening lecture or page location appears.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No "the X you did/saw/caught" backward-beat reference appears in the body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No guess/predict-before-reveal instruction appears in the body.
Each chunk carries a standalone design move: identify the bottleneck, draft both plans, and hand the plan to its test.
The headings accurately summarize their chunks: finding the bottleneck, drafting both plans, and carrying the plan forward.
The body has no banned cadence construction, self-grading superlative, empty verb triplet, number retraction, or abstraction-noun stack; the obstacle taxonomy is an explicit set of categories.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The body communicates in student-facing terms—bottleneck, technical plan, people plan, ownership, governance, and propagation—not repo-internal judge vocabulary.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Bold appears only on the Prompt label and the short UNASSIGNED marker; no narrative lead is made into a bold sentence.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The current Module 7 file includes this exercise at curriculum/trainings/agents-101/personal-to-team.md line 46; the target expands to three body chunks.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No Phase N or numbered step heading/reference appears in the body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No page-position pointer appears; the next exercise is named directly at line 63.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The only link is the structural exercise include-link to the next exercise, outside this rule's in-deck link inventory scope.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/exercises/design-the-sharing-plan.md reports 3 slides, oversized: 0, and every slide within limits.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: All three ## headings are exercise imperatives: "Find the absorption bottleneck", "Draft both plans", and "Carry the plan forward".
